modules.name: V2 Survival
modules.purpose: Servise tam olarak kaç gün kaldığından çok, belirli zaman aralıklarında (30/60/90/120 gün) servise gelme olasılığını modellemek; sağ-sansürlü kayıtları da kullanır. nb13 leakage-safe survival veri hazırlığı, nb14 baseline, nb15 advanced (CoxNet / XGBoost survival:cox & aft, tuned + IPCW-isotonic calibrated), nb16 production packaging (deterministic inference + /api/v2/* + golden parity). Champion: ENSEMBLE[XGB_COX+COXNET]. REAL FLEET VALIDATION: PENDING.

v0.report: Deterministic, rule-based next-service timing baseline (no ML). Serves as the reference floor for every V1 model. Synthetic v1.2 offline benchmark only — not production validation.

config.selection_rule: temporal-CV MAE + authoritative VALIDATION; TEST never consulted

verdict.executive_summary: Systematic temporal-CV Optuna tuning of HGB / LightGBM / XGBoost / CatBoost with target-specific feature selection and a validation-selected blend. KM verdict: MEANINGFUL IMPROVEMENT. DAYS verdict: SMALL IMPROVEMENT. Overall: SMALL IMPROVEMENT → V1 REGRESSION CLOSED.
verdict.practical_gain:
- DAYS: MAE +1.97%  ·  R² +0.0088  →  SMALL IMPROVEMENT
- KM: MAE +2.41%  ·  R² +0.0511  →  MEANINGFUL IMPROVEMENT
verdict.recommendation_v2: The next-service KM target on frozen v1.3 is model-saturated: temporal-CV tuning across four boosting families plus a blend does not move TEST R² materially, and TRAIN↔TEST drift (not model capacity) dominates the remaining error. Recommended next step: V2 survival analysis (right-censoring aware) rather than further V1 point-regression tuning. V2 recommended: YES.
